people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Shiloh
people.line: Israelite sanctuary and assembly point during the judges' period

translations.web: Yahweh appeared again in Shiloh; for Yahweh revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by Yahweh’s word.
translations.bsb: And the LORD continued to appear at Shiloh, because there He revealed Himself to Samuel by His word.
translations.kjv: And the LORD appeared again in Shiloh: for the LORD revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of the LORD.
translations.asv: And Jehovah appeared again in Shiloh; for Jehovah revealed himself to Samuel in Shiloh by the word of Jehovah.
